BackgroundNoise.description:
The background noise, one level for the experiment: looped on every speaker unequalised, faded in over 2 s once
the task file is read at Go (OpenRigs.Audio SpeakerMixer).

levelDbfs.description: The background noise's level in dBFS RMS: the RMS of the sound over its whole length as the task gives it, before the speaker's equalisation, against full scale (a full-scale sine is -3). The lab's default -50. The workflow stops when the task file is read at Go if any peak would reach -1 dBFS after equalisation
levelDbfs.title: LevelDbfs

BackgroundNoise.title: BackgroundNoise

OptogeneticsConfig.description:
Zapit optogenetic stimulation: the lab's block (open_rigs.core.task Optogenetics) and the corridor's laser timing.

The stimulation sites and ramp-down are set in the Zapit conditions file loaded in Zapit, not here; Bonsai reads
the same file to list its conditions. "Stimulus" is the tone and grating; the laser is continuous: it starts at the
trigger (the trigger line's rising edge on a hardware-triggered rig), laser_to_stimulus_seconds before the first
tone pip (after it if negative), in whole 50 ms beeps and at most 0.2 s, and Bonsai stops it at the trial's
outcome, or after laser_max_seconds if that comes first. A trial that ends before its trigger has no laser.

useZapit.description: Whether Zapit runs this experiment: every trial sends it a condition from the conditions file (laser off at 0 mW on laser-off trials: the galvos move and the masking light shows), and the launching app checks Zapit is answering before Go
useZapit.title: UseZapit

zapitConfigPath.description: Path to the Zapit conditions file loaded in Zapit. Its top-level stimLocations01, stimLocations02, ... entries are the conditions, numbered 1 to N with no gaps. Named ...ConfigPath so the launching app keeps a copy beside the task file at Go
zapitConfigPath.title: ZapitConfigPath

laserPowerMw.description: Laser power on laser-on trials, in mW, the same for every condition: sent to Zapit with each StartStimulus (overriding the conditions file's power; Zapit's laser calibration turns it into volts) and logged as laserPowerMw (0 on laser-off trials). Required with optogenetics on
laserPowerMw.title: LaserPowerMw

laserOnProbability.description: Probability that a trial after trialsBeforeLaser is a laser-on trial, shared equally by every condition in the conditions file; all other trials are laser-off trials, sent a condition with the laser off
laserOnProbability.title: LaserOnProbability

laserToStimulusSeconds.description: Signed, in seconds: the trigger (the ZapitTrigger line) comes this long before the stimulus; 0 with it; negative after it. Go is the end of the interval less the lead, max(this, 0), once the stage's quiet waits hold, and the stimulus comes the lead after Go in every experiment, optogenetics on or off, so timing never reveals Zapit; the trigger only with optogenetics. Zapit is armed during the interval and adds no time. Refused above itiMinSeconds - 0.2 s (Zapit's reply margin); each task adds its own limits
laserToStimulusSeconds.title: LaserToStimulusSeconds

trialsBeforeLaser.description: Trials at the experiment's start with no laser-on trial among them (each still sends Zapit a condition, at 0 mW); laserOnProbability applies from the next trial
trialsBeforeLaser.title: TrialsBeforeLaser

laserMaxSeconds.description: Longest the laser stays on in one trial, in seconds from the trigger, timed by Bonsai; it then ramps down over the condition's offRampDownDuration_ms. A safety cap: the laser normally stops at the trial's outcome. Timed on the Harp clock, with a wall-clock backstop should the board stall. With optogenetics on it must be at least the longest stage timeLimitSeconds + laser_to_stimulus_seconds + 0.25 s (the laser runs from the first pip less laser_to_stimulus_seconds to at most the first pip plus timeLimitSeconds), so it never ends a timed-out trial's laser early; on a stage without timeLimitSeconds a longer trial loses its laser before the outcome
laserMaxSeconds.title: LaserMaxSeconds

triggerHoldSeconds.description: How long the trigger line, and the masking light on it, stays high after the outcome, in seconds, on every trial of an optogenetics experiment (the line stays low without optogenetics): at least 0.5, the longest ramp-down a conditions file may have, and at most trialStructure.itiMinSeconds - laser_to_stimulus_seconds - 0.2 s, since the next trial is armed once the line falls and Zapit's reply needs 0.2 s before its trigger
triggerHoldSeconds.title: TriggerHoldSeconds

Penalty.description:
What a wrong or missed trial costs: a timeout, and the penalty sound with it (the trial log's penaltySound and
penaltyTimeoutSeconds). Each task says which trials are penalised; timeoutSeconds has no lab default: each task file gives it.

timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout after a penalised trial, in seconds; the next interval starts after it
timeoutSeconds.title: TimeoutSeconds

sound.description: The penalty sound, with every timeout
sound.title: Sound

Penalty.title: Penalty

PenaltySound.description: The lab's penalty sound (OpenRigs.Audio PenaltySoundBuffer, the same in every task), on rig.yml's speakerArray.penaltySoundChannel alone, equalised for that speaker.

enabled.description: Whether the penalty sound plays with every timeout
enabled.title: Enabled

levelDbfs.description: The penalty sound's level in dBFS RMS: the RMS of the sound over its whole length as the task gives it, before the speaker's equalisation, against full scale (a full-scale sine is -3). The lab's default -30. The workflow stops when the task file is read at Go if any peak would reach -1 dBFS after equalisation
levelDbfs.title: LevelDbfs

PenaltySound.title: PenaltySound

RewardTone.description: A task's reward tone, played at levelDbfs.

levelDbfs.description: The reward tone's level in dBFS RMS: the RMS of the sound over its whole length as the task gives it, before the speaker's equalisation, against full scale (a full-scale sine is -3). The lab's default -36. The workflow stops when the task file is read at Go if any peak would reach -1 dBFS after equalisation
levelDbfs.title: LevelDbfs

RewardTone.title: RewardTone

StimulusSound.description: A task's stimulus sounds, each played at levelDbfs (OpenRigs.Audio SpeakerBuffer or SpeakerSet.Buffer).

levelDbfs.description: Each stimulus sound's level in dBFS RMS: the RMS of the sound over its whole length as the task gives it, before the speaker's equalisation, against full scale (a full-scale sine is -3). The lab's default -30. The workflow stops when the task file is read at Go if any peak would reach -1 dBFS after equalisation
levelDbfs.title: LevelDbfs

StimulusSound.title: StimulusSound

TrainingStage.description: One row of the training stage table: what the stage does, its quiet waits the lab's (open_rigs.core.task QuietWait). Rows are selected by the TrainingStage setting.

lickQuietSeconds.description: Quiet wait: Go needs this long with every spout released, in seconds, counted from the interval's start and restarted by every touch and release; a held contact (a paw or chin on a spout) holds Go until released, so licks for the last reward cannot carry into the next trial; 0: off. It lengthens the interval only when the mouse licks late in it (quietWaitSeconds)
lickQuietSeconds.title: LickQuietSeconds

wheelQuietSeconds.description: Quiet wait: Go needs this long with the wheel still, in seconds, counted from the interval's start: the wheel's distance (forward and back added) over the last wheelQuietSeconds must stay within wheelQuietCm; 0: off (with wheelQuietCm 0)
wheelQuietSeconds.title: WheelQuietSeconds

wheelQuietCm.description: The most the wheel may move, forward and back added, within the last wheelQuietSeconds before Go, in cm; 0: off (with wheelQuietSeconds 0)
wheelQuietCm.title: WheelQuietCm

rewardFloorHz.description: Lower frequency of the reward zone, in Hz
rewardFloorHz.title: RewardFloorHz

rewardCeilingHz.description: Upper frequency of the reward zone, in Hz
rewardCeilingHz.title: RewardCeilingHz

rewardSizeUl.description: Microlitres each reward gives, at most 20 (the most one reward may ask for), on the left spout's valve, planned from the valve's calibration (calibration\valve-DO1.json). An uncalibrated valve stops the workflow at Start
rewardSizeUl.title: RewardSizeUl

lickToReward.description: Whether a lick in the zone earns the reward; false rewards reaching the zone, no lick needed
lickToReward.title: LickToReward

wrongLickLimit.description: Licks outside the zone that end the trial; 0: wrong licks never end it
wrongLickLimit.title: WrongLickLimit

penaliseWrongZone.description: Whether a trial that ends outside the reward zone is penalised. A trial that runs out of time or track with the frequency in the zone is penalised on every stage
penaliseWrongZone.title: PenaliseWrongZone

timeLimitSeconds.description: The longest a trial runs from its first tone pip, in seconds, after which it ends as a Timeout; null: no limit
timeLimitSeconds.title: TimeLimitSeconds

trackEndEndsTrial.description: Whether reaching the end of the track ends the trial
trackEndEndsTrial.title: TrackEndEndsTrial

trackLengthScale.description: The drawn track length is multiplied by this
trackLengthScale.title: TrackLengthScale

frequencyDrift.description: Whether the frequency also drifts up with time, not only with distance run
frequencyDrift.title: FrequencyDrift

truncatedTrialFraction.description: Fraction of trials whose stimulus switches off early (truncation.sweepFractions)
truncatedTrialFraction.title: TruncatedTrialFraction

TrainingStage.title: TrainingStage

itiMinSeconds.description: Lower bound of the inter-trial interval, drawn uniformly for every trial, in seconds: from the last trial's outcome (after any penalty timeout; trial 1: the first clock tick after Go) to this trial's first tone pip, with a quiet mouse. It includes the time to drink a reward (Tom Childs' fixed 2 s before his 0 or 1 s); the stage's quiet waits can only lengthen it (quietWaitSeconds)
itiMinSeconds.title: ItiMinSeconds

itiMaxSeconds.description: Upper bound of the uniformly drawn inter-trial interval, in seconds (itiMinSeconds)
itiMaxSeconds.title: ItiMaxSeconds

trackLengthsCm.description: Track lengths, one drawn per trial and scaled by the stage's trackLengthScale, in cm
trackLengthsCm.title: TrackLengthsCm

Truncation.description:
Where the stimulus switches off on a truncated trial (a stage's truncatedTrialFraction says how many).

On a truncated trial the stimulus (tone and grating) switches off part way along the sweep. Everything else about
the trial is unchanged, so it is still rewarded as normal: the animal has to keep going and find the reward
zone without the stimulus.

sweepFractions.description: Where the stimulus switches off, as a fraction of the sweep on a log scale, split evenly over truncated trials. The reward floor is at about 0.8
sweepFractions.title: SweepFractions

Truncation.title: Truncation

rngSeed.description: Seed of the random number generator for these task parameters
rngSeed.title: RngSeed

modality.description: What the trial shows: the tone sweep (auditory), the grating (visual) or both (audiovisual)
modality.title: Modality

tonePips.description: The tone sweep's pips (src/waveforms/all_waveforms.bin), each played at levelDbfs (open_rigs.core.task StimulusSound)
tonePips.title: TonePips

rewardTone.description: The reward tone (src/waveforms/reward_tone.bin), played at levelDbfs (open_rigs.core.task RewardTone)

backgroundNoise.description: The background white noise (src/waveforms/background_noise.bin) on every speaker, from Go (open_rigs.core.task BackgroundNoise)

positionStepCm.description: The distance run is rounded to this before it sets the frequency, in cm
positionStepCm.title: PositionStepCm

penalty.description: The timeout and penalty sound a penalised trial gets (open_rigs.core.task Penalty)

truncation.description: Where the stimulus switches off on a truncated trial

trainingStages.description: Training stage table, indexed by the TrainingStage setting from 0; a setting past the end stops the workflow at Go
trainingStages.title: TrainingStages
